title: Competitive-baselines recurring pass: per-venture market baseline feeding stage scoring and chairman packets
executive_summary: Makes competitive_baselines (the only one of 3 pre-existing competitor tables with a live downstream consumer -- the Stage 5/13 advisory gate) the recurring competitive-baseline home. Replaces its synthetic STATUS_QUO placeholder rows with real, cited research for eligible active ventures, adds staleness columns, and wires an optional never-blocking section into the chairman S24 packet. First specimen: AltifyAI (schema/pipeline validation only -- venture is cancelled, so no live S24 sitting is claimed).

functional_requirements.title: Staleness columns on competitive_baselines
functional_requirements.description: ADD COLUMN produced_at timestamptz, expires_at timestamptz to competitive_baselines (supabase/migrations/, plain additive -- no CHECK-constraint widening, no NOT NULL without default, self-applies under the TIER-1 provably-additive path per database/chairman-gated/README.md). Mirrors the fetched_at/expires_at convention on product_hunt_cache (supabase/migrations/20260323_product_hunt_cache.sql).

functional_requirements.title: Citation persistence shape
functional_requirements.description: Add a citations JSONB field (or extend an existing JSONB field, e.g. analysis_data) on competitive_baselines to hold per-claim citation objects (source url, title, retrieved_at, origin-independence note), matching the Proven/Better/New gate's per-field citation-object pattern (not a fused blob).

functional_requirements.title: Venture-eligibility predicate
functional_requirements.description: The recurring pass MUST filter active ventures through an isFixtureVenture-class predicate (reuse or extend lib/chairman/chairman-actionable.mjs's isFixtureVenture, precedent: QF-20260829-286) before querying/writing -- of 92 status=active ventures, 91 are test/e2e fixtures; only ApexNiche AI (809ec7e7-...) is real. Zero Tavily calls or baseline writes against fixture ventures.

functional_requirements.title: Real baseline research replaces STATUS_QUO placeholders
functional_requirements.description: CompetitiveBaselineService (lib/discovery/competitive-baseline-service.js) gains a real research path using lib/eva/utils/web-search.js (Tavily wrapper, already used by Stage 4) to populate pricing_data/feature_coverage/performance_metrics/epistemic_tag with cited, non-placeholder data for eligible ventures. The existing ensureBaselines()/STATUS_QUO auto-create path is not removed (still the safety fallback when research is unavailable) but is no longer the only path.

functional_requirements.title: Recurring schedule
functional_requirements.description: A scheduled or stage-triggered refresh (reuse an existing cron/quiet-tick cadence per this repo's established convention -- do not build new scheduler infra) re-runs the baseline research per eligible venture, respecting the declared shelf-life (expires_at) so a fresh, non-expired baseline is not re-researched on every tick.

functional_requirements.title: Chairman packet integration (never-wait)
functional_requirements.description: lib/eva/chairman-product-review.js:generateReviewPacket() gains a competitive-baseline section mirroring its existing optional-verdict pattern (lines 209-215: `const verdict = await loadVerdictSummary(...); if (verdict) { ... }`). The baseline read is best-effort: absent, stale, or errored baseline data results in the packet proceeding with a baseline-unavailable marker, never a thrown error or an await that can hang the S24 choke-point (stage-execution-worker.js:2998-3062).

functional_requirements.title: AltifyAI specimen (simulation-scoped)
functional_requirements.description: Produce one real, cited baseline row for AltifyAI (50763b6a-1fad-4e1e-b2fc-296a1d66ebf9) via the FR-4 research path. Because AltifyAI is status=cancelled at stage 23 (verified by coordinator 2026-08-29T21:39Z, a chairman-facing 'AltifyAI is in live UAT' receipt was independently found false on the same measurement and routed to Adam/Solomon), do NOT claim a live S24 sitting consumed this baseline. Verify the never-wait property via SIMULATED packet assembly (call generateReviewPacket()-equivalent logic directly against AltifyAI's venture_id) with the baseline present, then again with it absent/stale -- both must complete without blocking.

functional_requirements.title: Outreach fence
functional_requirements.description: Research log/audit trail (reuse existing logging conventions) demonstrates zero outbound contact -- only lib/eva/utils/web-search.js (read-only search) is invoked, never any email/CRM/outreach surface.

technical_requirements.description: Migration confined to ADD COLUMN on competitive_baselines -- no schema change to competitors or competitor_intelligence (explicitly out of scope, a future consolidation SD's job).
Venture eligibility check must run BEFORE any Tavily call is issued -- a fixture venture must never reach the web-search step, not merely be excluded from the final write.

FR-6's packet integration must be wrapped in the same fail-soft pattern as the existing verdict section (try/catch or equivalent) -- a baseline-service exception must never propagate into generateReviewPacket()'s caller.

architecture.approach: Extend the existing competitive_baselines table and CompetitiveBaselineService rather than adding new infrastructure. Reuse existing scheduler cadence, existing web-search wrapper, existing packet-assembly optional-section pattern, and the QF-286-precedent fixture-venture filter.
architecture.risk_mitigation: Eligibility filter runs first (TR-2) so no cost/pollution risk on fixture ventures. Packet integration is fail-soft (TR-3) so the S24 choke-point can never hang on this instrument, satisfying Solomon's binding condition.

implementation_phases.name: Research path + eligibility
implementation_phases.description: FR-3 (eligibility predicate) + FR-4 (real research replacing STATUS_QUO placeholder path).

implementation_phases.name: Scheduling + packet integration
implementation_phases.description: FR-5 (recurring schedule) + FR-6 (chairman packet never-wait section).

implementation_phases.name: Specimen + verification
implementation_phases.description: FR-7 (AltifyAI baseline + simulated packet assembly, both branches) + FR-8 (outreach-fence audit).

test_scenarios.description: Eligibility filter excludes all 91 known fixture-pattern ventures and includes only ApexNiche AI (and any future real active venture) -- zero web-search calls issued for excluded ventures.
A fresh (non-expired) baseline is not re-researched on a second scheduled tick; an expired one is.
Simulated packet assembly with a present, fresh AltifyAI baseline includes the competitive-baseline section.
Simulated packet assembly with the baseline absent (or a service exception) PROCEEDS and labels the gap -- no thrown error, no hang, matching Solomon's binding condition.
Migration applies cleanly (additive, no CHECK widening, no backfill of the 4 existing STATUS_QUO rows required).

risks.risk: Real Tavily research calls have API cost and rate limits, unlike the free synthetic STATUS_QUO placeholder path.
risks.mitigation: Eligibility filter (FR-3/TR-2) bounds this to exactly the real active-venture set (currently 1), and expires_at prevents redundant re-research.

risks.risk: A chairman-facing claim about a venture's live status (e.g. 'in UAT') can drift out of sync with the ventures table, as independently discovered during this SD's LEAD phase (a false AltifyAI-in-UAT receipt was caught and routed to Adam/Solomon).
risks.mitigation: This SD does not fix that class of drift (out of scope); the specimen's own framing was corrected to avoid repeating the same mistake in this SD's own claims.
